name: Philip the evangelist
role: One of the Seven, who preached in Samaria and baptised the Ethiopian
whenBasis: From the choosing of the Seven in the first years of the Jerusalem church to Paul's stay in his house on the way to Jerusalem, ≈AD 57.
summary: One of the seven chosen with Stephen. When persecution scattered the church, he went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ; the crowds listened, unclean spirits came out, and many were baptised, Simon the sorcerer among them. An angel sent him to the desert road to Gaza, where he met an Ethiopian official of Queen Candace reading Isaiah in his chariot. Philip told him the good news about Jesus and baptised him, and the Spirit carried Philip away. He preached from Azotus to Caesarea, where Paul stayed with him years later.
body: He runs up to the chariot and asks, “Do you understand what you are reading?” The eunuch asks what is to prevent him from being baptised; they go down into the water together. Luke calls him Philip the evangelist and says he had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.

moments.text: “Do you understand what you are reading?”

later.text: Papias, as quoted by Eusebius, knew his daughters at Hierapolis. Polycrates calls the Philip buried there with his daughters “one of the twelve apostles”, while Luke gives the daughters who prophesied to Philip the evangelist (Acts 21:8–9).
